title: Invisible Shield Priming Sunscreen SPF 50
descriptionHtml:
✓ SPF✓ Good for: Anti-Aging✓ Vegan✓ Non-Comedogenic✓ Fragrance Free✓ Good for: Uneven Texture

What it is: A daily, lightweight, broad-spectrum chemical sunscreen that protects skin with invisible skin-perfecting finish that primes skin for makeup application.


Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily


Skincare Concerns: Fine Lines and Wrinkles, Dryness, and Redness


Formulation: Lightweight Gel


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Chemical Sun Filters: Absorb and neutralize UV rays for UVA and UVB protection.

- Rice Phyto-Compounds: Guard against free radicals and protect skin from pollution and blue light.

- Aloe Leaf Juice: Gently soothes skin.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
-Apply sunscreen to face and neck as the last skincare step after your moisturizer.

-Use before makeup for daily sun protection.

-Apply 15 minutes before sun exposure.

-Re-apply every two hours for maximum protection.


Recycling Instructions:
-Like many tubes in the industry, this tube is made of multiple materials, which unfortunately makes it non-recyclable.

-To dispose of the secondary carton, unlock both top and bottom flaps and lay completely flat.

-Place in normal curbside paper recycling.

Ingredients+

-Chemical Sun Filters: Absorb and neutralize UV rays for UVA and UVB protection.

-Rice Phyto-Compounds: Guard against free radicals and protect skin from pollution and blue light.

-Aloe Leaf Juice: Gently soothes skin.


Avobenzone 3%, Homosalate 7%, Octisalate 5%, Octocrylene 10%, Isododecane, Dimethicone/Bis-Isobutyl PPG-20 Crosspolymer, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Butyloctyl Salicylate, Polysilicone-22, Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Dicaprylyl Ether, Glycine Soja (Soybean) Oil, Carthamus Tinctorius (Safflower) Seed Oil, Polyglyceryl-3 Diisostearate, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Germ Extract, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Extract, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Bisabolol, Tocopherol, Zingiber Officinale (Ginger) Root Extract.
